images.description: Morning window with condensation, a sweeping clean trail and yellow sponge. Used on the entrance and discovery feed.
images.processing: Source PNG retained; 720px-wide WebP quality 85; 432px-wide feed preview quality 82.

images.description: The same morning window with every fog, drop, bubble and sponge removed. Revealed under the interactive dirt mask in practice and HIDE. HIDE never renders a raw camera frame.

music.title: お掃除しましょ
music.creator: ゆうり (Yuli Audio Craft)
music.conditions: Creator follows the site license. Commercial game background use and editing are permitted within those terms. Music is used as an accompaniment to the game, not as a listening feature or downloadable audio. No BGM is supplied in user-created exports.
music.acquisition: Official download form GET + CSRF POST, track 1. Site license, site terms and creator conditions checked on 2026-10-04.
music.processing: Opening 48 seconds; loudnorm -20 LUFS, -2 dB true peak, 50ms fade-in, final two-second fade-out; stereo MP3 96 kbit/s, 44.1kHz.
music.delivery: Vite inline MP3 inside a lazy JS music module. Shared BGM mute/pause/foreground/result/exit lifecycle. Never fetched on entrance or feed.

effects.procedural: Original Web Audio readiness tones and rising four-note PERFECT chord. No microphone. Exported replay is silent.
